title: Buffalo Chicken Rice Bowls
description: Shredded chicken tossed in buffalo sauce over brown rice with crunchy celery and a cooling dressing.
ingredients: 60 g Greek yogurt ranch or blue cheese dressing
steps: Toss the shredded chicken with the buffalo sauce.
Divide the rice into bowls and top with the chicken and celery.
Drizzle with the dressing and scatter over scallions.

source.label: Adapted from Skinnytaste buffalo chicken rice bowls

notes: Using rotisserie or pre-cooked chicken makes this a genuine 10-minute assembly meal.
